name: branch-management
description: Branch lifecycle skills. new-branch cuts a fresh branch inline; new-pr runs iterative /code-review --fix review rounds, applies fixes between rounds, opens a PR/MR via gh or glab, and watches CI until green.

review_level.title: Code review effort level
review_level.description: Values: low / medium / high / xhigh / max — passed to /code-review as the effort level. low = fast, high-confidence findings only; medium = balanced coverage; high = broader, may include uncertain findings; xhigh = deeper reasoning; max = maximum coverage. Default: medium.

ci_monitor.title: CI monitoring
ci_monitor.description: Values: true = watch CI results after the PR/MR is opened; false = stop after opening the PR/MR. Default: true.

ci_watch_timeout.title: CI watch timeout (seconds)
ci_watch_timeout.description: Values: positive whole-number seconds for the CI watch deadline; invalid or missing values fall back to 1800. Default: 1800.

coderabbit_ci_comments.title: CodeRabbit CI comments
coderabbit_ci_comments.description: Values: true = collect and address open CodeRabbit bot comments while watching CI; false = ignore them. Default: true.

delete_branch_on_merge.title: Delete branch on merge
delete_branch_on_merge.description: Values: true = after opening the PR/MR, enable automatic deletion of the head/source branch when it merges (GitHub: sets the repo delete_branch_on_merge setting via gh api, idempotent, soft-fails without admin; GitLab: passes --remove-source-branch); false = leave branch-deletion settings untouched. Default: true.

rebase_before_pr.title: Rebase onto base before PR
rebase_before_pr.description: Values: true = in new-pr, after committing and before pushing, rebase the work branch onto origin/<base> when the base branch (usually main) gained new upstream commits (force-with-lease push; stops on conflict); false = skip the rebase. Default: true.

review_max_rounds.title: Max review rounds
review_max_rounds.description: Values: positive whole-number cap on iterative review rounds; invalid or missing values fall back to 3. Default: 3.
